defs.meaning: 专注的，目标明确的；（声音或图像）清晰的
集中，关注；聚焦，调焦；<语言学>以（句子的一部分）为焦点（或重心）（focus 的过去式和过去分词形式）

examples.en: The discussion focused on three main problems.
examples.zh: 讨论集中在三个主要问题上。

examples.en: Research has focused on improving the car's aerodynamics.
examples.zh: 研究的重点是改善轿车的流线型。

examples.en: She should do well in her studies this year—she's very focused.
examples.zh: 今年她的功课应该学得好，她的注意力很集中。

translations: 注意力；集中注意，集中注重
聚焦束（声束、光束、电子束）

pastExamSents.en: While rock-climbing, you need to remain very focused so that you won't make any dangerous errors.
pastExamSents.zh: 在攀岩的时候，你需要保持非常专注，这样你就不会犯任何危险的错误。

pastExamSents.en: I had only focused on the fact that it was another school project and one I wanted to get a good grade on.
pastExamSents.zh: 我只是注意到这样一个事实，这是学校的另一个项目，而且我想在此项目上取得好成绩。

pastExamSents.en: Many experts have given talks here that have focused on the medical care, and the development of public services for senior citizens.
pastExamSents.zh: 很多专家在这里做过关于医疗保健和老年人公共服务发展的演讲。

pastExamSents.en: We were respectful of craft and focused on digging into the characters we were going to play.
pastExamSents.zh: 我们尊重工艺，专注于挖掘我们将要扮演的角色。
